note: Simple guide as of 2026-10-29. This is not legal, tax, or career advice; always check the official site or consult a professional. Links were opened and verified on 2026-10-29 (✓ = site up but blocks automated checks).

items.title: What is a job family?
steps: A job family is a group of related jobs, for example Health, IT, Sales, Admin, Skilled trades, or Education.
Every job has three questions: What does the person do? What skills does it take? How do you start?
Look at vacancies on PhilJobNet (DOLE) to see what employers are hiring for now.
Pick 2 job families that interest you. · Find 3 job posts on PhilJobNet.
steps_tl: Ang job family ay grupo ng magkakaugnay na trabaho, hal. Health, IT, Sales, Admin, Skilled trades, Education.
Bawat trabaho ay may 3 tanong: Ano ang ginagawa? Anong skills? Paano magsimula?
Tingnan ang mga bakanteng trabaho sa PhilJobNet (DOLE) para makita kung ano ang hinahanap ngayon.
Pumili ng 2 job family na interesado ka · Maghanap ng 3 job post sa PhilJobNet
items.tip: There is no lesser job. Every role is needed for a community to work.
items.tip_tl: Walang 'mababang' trabaho: lahat ng role ay kailangan para gumana ang komunidad.

items.title: Skilled trades and TESDA roles
steps: Examples: electrician, welder, cook, caregiver, automotive technician, hairdresser.
Why it matters: these roles keep homes, food, vehicles, and care running.
Skills: hands-on work, safety, and attention to detail. A start: TESDA training and a National Certificate (NC) assessment.
Find the course you want on the TESDA site. · Find the nearest training center.
steps_tl: Halimbawa: electrician, welder, cook, caregiver, automotive, hairdressing.
Bakit mahalaga: sila ang nagpapatakbo ng bahay, pagkain, sasakyan at pag-aalaga.
Skills: hands-on, safety, attention to detail. Simula: TESDA training at National Certificate (NC) assessment.
Hanapin ang kursong gusto mo sa TESDA · Alamin ang pinakamalapit na training center
items.tip: Many TESDA courses are free or have a scholarship. Check the site.
items.tip_tl: Maraming TESDA course ay libre o may scholarship; i-check ang site.

items.title: Office, IT & digital roles
items.title_tl: Office, IT at digital na trabaho
steps: Examples: customer service, virtual assistant, data entry, web developer, IT support, bookkeeper.
Why it matters: these roles help a business talk to customers and keep records and systems in order.
Skills: communication in English and Filipino, computer basics, and organization. For IT, coding or troubleshooting.
A start: free online courses, a small portfolio, and applications on PhilJobNet or freelance sites.
Make a simple resume. · Learn 1 new tool this week.
steps_tl: Halimbawa: customer service, virtual assistant, data entry, web developer, IT support, bookkeeper.
Bakit mahalaga: tumutulong sa negosyo na makausap ang customer at maayos ang records at systems.
Skills: komunikasyon sa English/Filipino, computer basics, organisasyon; para sa IT, coding o troubleshooting.
Simula: libreng online courses, maliit na portfolio, at apply sa PhilJobNet o freelance sites.
Gumawa ng simpleng resume · Matuto ng 1 bagong tool ngayong linggo
items.tip: Watch for job scams. You should not have to pay to be hired.
items.tip_tl: Mag-ingat sa job scam: hindi dapat magbayad para matanggap.

items.title: Health, education & public service roles
steps: Examples: nurse, midwife, barangay health worker, teacher, social worker, police officer, firefighter.
Why it matters: they care for, teach, and protect the public.
A start: these often need a degree and a board exam or license (PRC), or civil service eligibility. Check the official requirements.
List the requirements of 1 role you want.
steps_tl: Halimbawa: nurse, midwife, barangay health worker, teacher, social worker, pulis, bumbero.
Bakit mahalaga: sila ang nag-aalaga, nagtuturo at nagpoprotekta sa publiko.
Simula: kadalasang kailangan ng degree at board exam/lisensya (PRC) o civil service eligibility; i-check ang official requirements.
Ilista ang requirements ng 1 role na gusto mo
items.tip: Labor and employment statistics are published by the PSA.
items.tip_tl: Labor at employment stats ay makikita sa PSA.

items.title: Step 1: Idea and a simple plan
steps: Answer: What will you sell? Who will buy it? How much capital do you need, and what is the price?
Try small first (for example a pre-order with people you know) before spending a lot.
Use Business.gov.ph to see the registration steps.
Write a 1-page plan. · Add up the capital you need.
steps_tl: Sagutin: Ano ang ibebenta? Sino ang bibili? Magkano ang puhunan at presyo?
Subukan muna nang maliit (hal. pre-order sa kakilala) bago gumastos nang malaki.
Gamitin ang Business.gov.ph para makita ang mga hakbang sa pagrehistro.
Isulat ang 1-pahinang plano · Kuwentahin ang puhunan
items.tip: Do not borrow a large amount for the first trial.
items.tip_tl: Huwag mangutang nang malaki para sa unang subok.

items.title: Step 2: Register the name or the company
steps: Sole proprietor (just you): a business name on DTI BNRS online.
Corporation, OPC, or partnership: SEC.
Cooperative: CDA.
Choose the type of business. · Check whether the name is available.
steps_tl: Sole proprietor (ikaw lang): business name sa DTI BNRS online.
Corporation, OPC o partnership: SEC.
Kooperatiba: CDA.
Pumili ng uri ng negosyo · I-check kung available ang pangalan
items.tip: Register only on the official site. The official fee is listed there.
items.tip_tl: Sa official site lang mag-register; may opisyal na fee na makikita roon.

items.title: Step 3: Barangay clearance and Mayor's permit
items.title_tl: Hakbang 3: Barangay clearance at Mayor's permit
steps: Get a barangay business clearance for the place where the business will operate.
Apply for a Mayor's or Business Permit at the city or municipal hall (BPLO). Requirements differ by LGU.
Ask your LGU's BPLO for the list of requirements.
steps_tl: Kumuha ng barangay business clearance kung saan ang puwesto.
Mag-apply ng Mayor's / Business Permit sa City o Municipal Hall (BPLO). Iba-iba ang requirements bawat LGU.
Tanungin ang BPLO ng inyong LGU ang listahan ng requirements
items.tip: Renew the business permit every year, usually in January.
items.tip_tl: Renew taun-taon ang business permit, kadalasan tuwing Enero.

items.title: Step 4: BIR registration (including freelancers)
steps: Anyone with business or freelance income must register with the BIR, even if the work is only online.
Use BIR ORUS (online) for registration and a TIN.
Freelancer or self-employed: learn the right tax option and the filing deadlines on the BIR site.
Issue an official invoice or receipt and keep records.
Register on ORUS. · List the filing deadlines.
steps_tl: Lahat ng may kita sa negosyo o freelance ay dapat mag-register sa BIR, kahit online lang.
Gamitin ang ORUS (online) ng BIR para sa registration at TIN.
Freelancer/self-employed: alamin ang tamang tax option at filing deadlines sa BIR site.
Mag-issue ng official invoice/resibo at itago ang records.
Mag-register sa ORUS · Ilista ang filing deadlines
items.tip: If this is confusing, consult a licensed accountant.
items.tip_tl: Kung nalilito, kumunsulta sa lisensyadong accountant.

items.title: Step 5: SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG
steps: If you are self-employed or an owner, register as a self-employed or voluntary member.
When you have employees, register as an employer and remit their contributions.
Update your membership with all three agencies.
steps_tl: Self-employed o may-ari: mag-register bilang self-employed/voluntary member.
Kapag may empleyado: i-register sila bilang employer at maghulog ng kontribusyon.
I-update ang membership sa 3 ahensya
items.tip: Contributions now are protection for illness, loans, and old age.
items.tip_tl: Ang hulog ngayon ay proteksyon mo sa sakit, loan at pagtanda.

items.title: Step 6: Negosyo Center and BMBE
steps: A Negosyo Center (DTI) gives free help with registration, training, and mentoring.
BMBE (RA 9178) is for small businesses (assets up to ₱3 million) and includes an income-tax exemption. Apply at a Negosyo Center.
Find the nearest Negosyo Center on the DTI site.
steps_tl: Negosyo Center (DTI): libreng tulong sa registration, training at mentoring.
BMBE (RA 9178): para sa maliliit na negosyo (assets hanggang ₱3M); may income tax exemption. Mag-apply sa Negosyo Center.
Hanapin ang pinakamalapit na Negosyo Center sa DTI site
items.tip: Check the current rules on the DTI site before you rely on a benefit.
items.tip_tl: I-check ang kasalukuyang patakaran sa DTI bago umasa sa benepisyo.

items.title: Agriculture & fisheries
steps: What it is: growing crops, raising animals, and fishing.
Why it matters: the country's food, and the livelihood of many provinces.
Example roles: farmer, agri-technician, fish farmer, food processor, agri-entrepreneur.
steps_tl: Ano: pagtatanim, paghahayupan, pangingisda.
Bakit mahalaga: pagkain ng bansa at kabuhayan ng maraming probinsya.
Halimbawang role: magsasaka, agri-technician, fish farmer, food processor, agri-entrepreneur.
items.tip: ATI and DA offer free farming training. See the Academy farming guides.
items.tip_tl: May libreng farming training ang ATI/DA; tingnan ang Academy farming guides.

items.title: Manufacturing & construction
steps: Manufacturing: electronics, food, garments. Roles: machine operator, QA inspector, technician, engineer.
Construction: houses, roads, bridges. Roles: mason, carpenter, electrician, foreman, civil engineer.
The BOI assists investments in industry.
steps_tl: Manufacturing: electronics, pagkain, damit. Role: machine operator, QA inspector, technician, engineer.
Construction: bahay, kalsada, tulay. Role: mason, karpintero, electrician, foreman, civil engineer.
BOI ang tumutulong sa mga investment sa industriya.
items.tip: Many roles here have a TESDA National Certificate path.
items.tip_tl: Maraming role dito ay may TESDA NC path.

items.title: IT-BPM & digital
steps: What it is: call centers, back office, software, animation, and health information.
Why it matters: it is one of the country's largest sources of jobs and of dollar earnings.
Roles: customer service representative, team lead, developer, QA tester, data analyst, virtual assistant.
steps_tl: Ano: call center, back office, software, animation, health information.
Bakit mahalaga: isa sa pinakamalaking pinagkukunan ng trabaho at dolyar ng bansa.
Role: customer service rep, team lead, developer, QA tester, data analyst, VA.

items.title: Tourism, healthcare & creative
steps: Tourism: hotel, resort, tour guide, travel agent, chef.
Healthcare: nurse, caregiver, medical technologist, barangay health worker.
Creative: design, video, music, writing, crafts, content creation.
Pick 1 industry and list 3 roles you want to try.
steps_tl: Tourism: hotel, resort, tour guide, travel agent, chef.
Healthcare: nurse, caregiver, med tech, barangay health worker.
Creative: design, video, music, writing, crafts, content creation.
Pumili ng 1 industriya at ilista ang 3 role na gusto mong subukan
items.tip: Use the PSA and DTI for official industry data.
items.tip_tl: Gamitin ang PSA at DTI para sa opisyal na datos ng industriya.

note_tl: Simpleng gabay noong 2026-10-29. Hindi ito legal, tax, o career advice; laging tingnan ang opisyal na site o kumunsulta sa eksperto. Binuksan at sinuri ang mga link noong 2026-10-29 (✓ = gumagana ang site pero hinaharangan ang automated check).
